title: (BETA) PulseCore Hub
features:
[PC RECOMMENDED]

DOES NOT SUPPORT MOBILE DEVICES. Well, the script will run on a phone, but it'll be extremely difficult to use.

The script is in BETA because it has quite a few bugs, but it's perfectly adequate for playing. Please report any bugs or errors in the script comments (I don't have a Discord server yet).

THIS SCRIPT IS PUBLISHED ONLY IN ScriptBlox AND rscripts

I am a Russian speaker, so if possible, use a translator to describe something in Russian so that I don't have to translate it myself.

by Marckoq (myself)
